stages.goal: Small next items found while releasing v0.43.0

items.title: Fix the Phase-1 build
items.benefit: Gave the green baseline everything else needs.

items.title: Make the cache actually hit
items.benefit: Live 0% hit / 66 s avg; the wrapper's headline value-add is non-functional `[repo]`.

items.title: Real signature inference from rlib metadata
items.benefit: Cross-crate calls are unsound guesses, blocking non-trivial programs `[repo]`.

items.title: Generics + trait dispatch (native path)
items.benefit: Traits/generics are pervasive in the workspace.

items.title: Decide frontend posture — own it OR formalize rustc-as-frontend
items.benefit: Load-bearing identity decision — the whitepaper's "self-hosting" claim is only honest under one of these. Route via a FIP (§12).

items.title: Own/vendor the linker
items.benefit: "No own linker" is a standalone gap `[repo]`.

items.title: Self-host `fluxc` via Phase 3
items.benefit: The whitepaper's central claim and the true test of standalone status — realistically last, gated on 3–7 (fluxc uses structs/enums/generics/traits heavily).

items.title: PRINCE2 board in flux-legacy (control::prince2 + flux-roadmap)
items.benefit: The roadmap cannot go stale unseen again: every item states its benefit and is re-checked every 30 days; tolerances say when an agent must ask Viktor

items.title: K-gauge labels honest: SIGIL gauge names the node's chain + g3's rate; Quillon k_parameter shows K_fix
items.benefit: Nobody quotes the wrong K: the SIGIL gauge named a dead chain (sigil-g2) and judged g3 against g2's block rate; the Quillon wallet tool printed a 0–100 mining score as 'the K-parameter'
items.done_check: fluxc test -p fluxc-mcp --lib sigil_kgauge (2 new tests) — live once fluxc is reinstalled and the MCP restarted

items.title: fluxc release fills flux_rev + source_tag in the signed manifest (both are hardcoded empty)
items.benefit: An installer can tie the downloaded binary to the exact source tree, instead of trusting the release notes

items.title: Done board items become signed flux-rev roadmap attestations (release_ref = the tag)
items.benefit: A done item can be checked by someone who does not trust the author: flux-rev roadmap hashes the code that implements it and signs it

exceptions.decision_note: Viktor 2026-11-15: "install the new fluxc so the mcp gets the fix"

lessons.text: A clean checkout of the flux main line cannot load its workspace: crates/sigil-rpc-wasm depends on sigil-rpc, deleted 09-22; the 4-line exclude sits UNCOMMITTED in the shared tree's Cargo.toml
A flux worktree must sit beside a 'sigil' link (ws/flux + ws/sigil): the SIGIL crates reach ../../../flux, so elsewhere cargo sees two flux-cache packages (lockfile collision)
The quillon-wallet MCP build/ is newer than its src/ (v2.21 swap checks exist only in build/index.js): never rebuild it from src/; patch build/ with exact anchors and mirror into src/
